metadata.description: Personal Claude Code plugins by Trang Nguyen. Themed plugins for product design, writing-style analysis, and personal workflows.

plugins.name: writing-skills
plugins.description: Skills for writing collaboration: analyse someone's writing style at scale (Drive docs or blog posts), and draft/review/iterate prose in a target voice with audience-aware critique.

plugins.name: reporting
plugins.description: Skills for reporting on your own work: summarise Claude Code activity into daily/weekly time breakdowns, drill down by ticket or tag, and format reports for terminal or chat delivery.
